ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) patches restricted to distal regions; ratio approximately 1:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized at the terminal tips of both lobes; a prominent dark, cross-hatched geometric pattern is mapped to the central-lower region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire span; multiple sharp peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes varying between 4 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex sweep of the distal edges, though heavily modulated by significant edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the tips and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, parallel low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and deep indentations along the trailing edge; prominent linear diagonal scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique dark, multi-linear cross-hatched configuration on the inner-right lobe.
